title: 「By and large」表示整體情況

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：By and large, + complete clause。

rules.zh: 通常放在句首，後面加逗號 不要漏掉逗號：
rules.en: The phrase normally comes first and is followed by a comma. Incorrect: By and large the plan worked well. Correct: By and large, the plan worked well.
examples: By and large, the plan worked well.
By and large the plan worked well. ✗
By and large, the plan worked well. ✓

rules.en: Follow it with a complete clause: By and large, + subject + verb + other information. Example: By and large, the students understood the lesson.
examples: By and large, + subject + verb + other information
By and large, the students understood the lesson.

rules.zh: 它表示「大致上」，而不是「毫無例外」 By and large 接近： 它並不表示：
rules.en: It means “generally”, not “without exception”. It is close to generally, overall, on the whole, for the most part and in most cases. It does not mean always, completely, without exception or every single time.

rules.zh: 適合概括整體表現或普遍趨勢 它常用來總結： ● 一項計劃是否成功； ● 大部分人的反應； ● 一段時間內的整體情況； ● 一個組織或制度的普遍表現； ● 考慮多項因素後所得出的整體評價。
rules.en: Use by and large to summarise whether a plan succeeded, how most people responded, the overall situation during a period, the general performance of an organisation or system, or an overall evaluation reached after weighing several factors.

rules.zh: 避免與過於絕對的字眼衝突 一般不宜寫： By and large 容許例外，但 every customer 和 completely 聽起來像完全沒有例外，意思容易 互相衝突。
rules.en: Avoid conflict with absolute wording. “By and large, every customer was completely satisfied” is generally unsuitable because by and large allows exceptions whereas every customer and completely suggest none.
examples: By and large, every customer was completely satisfied.

benefits.zh: 這個句型讓你概括主要情況，同時避免聲稱每一個個案都完全一樣。
benefits.en: It helps you make a balanced general statement This structure lets you describe the main situation without claiming that it is true in every single case.

benefits.zh: 你不需要逐一列出所有成功之處、問題和例外，也可以先讓讀者掌握整體情況。
benefits.en: It allows you to summarise a complicated situation quickly Instead of listing every success, problem and exception, you can give the reader the overall picture first.

benefits.zh: 使用 by and large 表示你知道事情可能存在例外，因此你的意見會顯得更公允和審慎。
benefits.en: It prevents your statement from sounding too absolute Using by and large shows that you recognise possible exceptions. This can make an opinion sound fairer and more careful.

benefits.zh: 它讓你不必重複使用 generally、overall、in general 和 on the whole，使句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to express “generally” or “overall” You can avoid repeatedly using generally, overall, in general and on the whole.

benefits.zh: 你可以在日常對話、作文、報告、評論和簡報中，用它作出整體判斷或總結。 Compare 比較 （少數顧客作出了投訴，但大部分顧客都對服務感到滿意。） （整體而言，顧客都對服務感到滿意。） 第二句把主要情況概括得更簡潔，同時仍然容許少數例外存在。
benefits.en: It is useful for conclusions and overall evaluations in conversations, essays, reports, reviews and presentations. Compare: A few customers complained, but most customers were satisfied with the service. By and large, customers were satisfied with the service. The second version summarises the main situation more concisely while still allowing for a few exceptions.
